sentences.en: WOMAN: Can I help you?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 需要帮忙吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, I've just moved to this area with my wife and children and I'd like to know where we can all register with a doctor at a Health Centre.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，我刚和妻子及孩子们搬到这一带，想了解一下我们全家可以在哪家健康中心登记注册家庭医生。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, there's Doctor Green at The Harvey Clinic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，哈维诊所的格林医生。

sentences.en: We always recommend her for babies, because she's very good with them and she Example runs a special clinic.
sentences.zh: 我们通常向有婴儿的家庭推荐她，因为她非常擅长照顾婴儿，而且她还开设了一个专门的诊所。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh ... actually my youngest child is five, so that wouldn't be any good for us.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦……其实我最小的孩子已经五岁了，所以这个对我们来说不太合适。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: MAN: Is there anywhere else | could try?
sentences.zh: MAN: 还有别的地方可以试试吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, the Eshcol Health Practice is the next one on my list.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 有，埃舍尔健康诊所是我名单上的下一家。

sentences.en: MAN: How do you spell that?
sentences.zh: MAN: 这个怎么拼写？

sentences.en: WOMAN: E-S-H-C-O-L.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: E-S-H-C-O-L。

sentences.en: And it's Doctor Fuller, who has space on his list.
sentences.zh: 那里是富勒医生，他的患者名单上还有空位。

sentences.en: The clinic only opened a year ago, so the facilities are all very modern.
sentences.zh: 该诊所一年前才开业，因此所有设施都非常现代化。

sentences.en: MAN: That sounds good.
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And it's particularly good if you're busy during the day, because they also do appointments in the evening.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 而且，如果你白天比较忙，那里尤其适合你，因为他们也提供晚间预约服务。

sentences.en: They're closed on Saturday, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，他们周六不营业。

sentences.en: The only other place on the list is the Health Centre on Shore Lane.
sentences.zh: 名单上唯一另一处地点是肖尔巷健康中心。

sentences.en: You can register with Doctor Gormley, that's G-O-R-M-L-E-Y.
sentences.zh: 你可以登记注册戈姆利医生，拼写是 G-O-R-M-L-E-Y。

sentences.en: He's new there, but the centre has a very good reputation.
sentences.zh: 他是新来的，但该中心声誉很好。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh yes, think know the road.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，是的，我想我知道那条路。

sentences.en: That would be the best one.
sentences.zh: 那会是最好的选择。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Could you tell me, will all their services be free?
sentences.zh: 请问，他们所有的服务都是免费的吗？

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com

sentences.en: WOMAN: Erm .. there are usually some small charges that doctors make.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯……医生通常会收取一些小额费用。

sentences.en: Let me see what it says about the Shore Lane Centre.
sentences.zh: 让我看看关于肖尔巷中心的说明。

sentences.en: If you need to be & 6 vaccinated before any trips abroad, you won't have to pay for this.
sentences.zh: 如果你在出国旅行前需要接种疫苗，这项服务是免费的。

sentences.en: Erm, what else?
sentences.zh: 嗯，还有什么呢？

sentences.en: The sports injury treatment service operates on a paying basis, as does the nutritional therapy service.
sentences.zh: 运动损伤治疗服务需自费，营养疗法服务也是如此。

sentences.en: Some health centres do offer alternative therapies like homeopathy as part of their pay-to-use service.
sentences.zh: 一些健康中心将顺势疗法等替代疗法作为付费使用的服务项目提供。

sentences.en: Shore Lane are hoping to do this soon - I think they may start with acupuncture.
sentences.zh: 肖尔巷中心正计划尽快推出此类服务——我想他们可能会先从针灸开始。

sentences.en: And finally, if you need to prove you're healthy or 05 & 6 haven't had any serious injuries before a new employer will accept you, you can get a free fitness check-up there, but you'd most likely have to pay for insurance medicals though.
sentences.zh: 最后，如果你需要向新雇主证明自己身体健康、未曾受过严重伤害，你可在该中心免费接受体能健康检查；但体检保险相关项目则很可能需要自费。

sentences.en: MAN: Okay, thanks.
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: WOMAN: You might also be interested to know the Centre is running a pilot scheme of talks for patients.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你可能也会感兴趣：该中心正在试行一项面向患者的讲座计划。

sentences.en: I've got the list here.
sentences.zh: 我这儿有份讲座清单。

sentences.en: Actually, they look very interesting.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这些讲座看起来非常有意思。

sentences.en: MAN: : What sort of things?
sentences.zh: MAN: 有哪些内容呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, the first one's about giving up smoking.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，第一场是关于戒烟的。

sentences.en: It's next week, the twenty- fifth of February, at 7 pm, and that's in Room 4.
sentences.zh: 就在下周，2月25日，晚上7点，在4号房间。

sentences.en: It says, the talk will stress the health benefits particularly for people with asthma or heart disease.
sentences.zh: 上面写着，这次讲座将着重强调健康益处，尤其针对哮喘或心脏病患者。

sentences.en: MAN: That sounds very interesting.
sentences.zh: MAN: 听起来非常有趣。

sentences.en: WOMAN: There's also a talk a for families with children.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 还有一场面向有孩子的家庭的讲座。

sentences.en: It's on Healthy Eating, and takes place on the first of March at five o'clock.
sentences.zh: 主题是‘健康饮食’，将于3月1日下午五点举行。

sentences.en: MAN: Will that be at the Health Centre?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那场讲座会在健康中心举办吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Erm, actually it's at the primary school on Shore Lane.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 呃，实际上它在肖尔巷小学举行。

sentences.en: I imagine they're inviting the parents of pupils there - it says here 'all welcome'.
sentences.zh: 我想他们是在邀请该校学生的家长——这里写着‘欢迎所有人参加’。

sentences.en: MAN: Mmm, I might go to that if I have time.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，如果我有时间的话，可能会去听听那场。

sentences.en: WOMAN: There's a couple of other talks - one giving advice about how to avoid injuries while doing exercise.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 还有另外几场讲座——其中一场提供有关如何在锻炼时避免受伤的建议。

sentences.en: It's on the ninth of March.
sentences.zh: 这场讲座在3月9日举行。

sentences.en: Oh, it's a late afternoon talk, at four thirty, and it'll be in Room 6. t also says the talk is suitable for all ages.
sentences.zh: 哦，这是一场下午稍晚的讲座，时间为下午四点半，地点在6号教室。文中还注明该讲座适合所有年龄段的人士。
